chunks: Wahb ibn Wahb narrated from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father عليه السلام, who said:
ʿAlī عليه السلام said: “The children of the polytheists are with their fathers in the Fire, and the children of the Muslims are with their fathers in Paradise.”

key_terms.الْمُسْلِمِينَ: the Muslims; those who submit to Allah
key_terms.الْمُشْرِكِينَ: the polytheists; those who associate partners with Allah

ai.seo_question: What does Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام say about the children of polytheists and Muslims in the afterlife?
ai.summary: This hadith attributes to Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام a statement about the fate of the children of polytheists and the children of Muslims in the afterlife. It presents an eschatological classification tied to their parents’ ultimate abode.
